scope: Exactly one precommitted held-out Native episode; separate from the benchmark. No alternate, second profile or camera recording.

attempt.note: A zero return code is not task success; the summary classifies the result.

task_outcome.scope: Read-only goal evaluation of recorded oracle material state; separate from the frozen v1 oracle

integrity.scope: Recording and persistent-history validity only; not the goal outcome

digit_scope.components_from: own digits, on the material not detached by earlier steps
own digits, on the material not detached by earlier steps

outcome.rule: every step must hold at the end of the episode; no unowned digit; final all-digit substrate integrity
outcome.scope: goal_eval_v2a: the goal_eval_v2 allocation and step scopes; every nonzero digit must be owned by a step; each step is scored on the workpiece it acted on (material earlier steps detached is out of its graph, mass base and location statistic, counts as removed for selected removal, and is not scored for unselected retention); a final all-digit check keeps the material below the lowest remove/trim plane in one anchored component per final sever piece; every threshold is the v1 threshold

digit_allocation.rule: declared convention (steps in order; sever one per plane, divide pieces - 1, remove_protrusions one per selected protrusion, trim_plane one, move_piece none)

final_all_digit_substrate.reason: No remove_protrusions/trim_plane step defines a substrate plane

task_outcome.provenance: Recomputed actual eight-node compatibility graph including positive weights, stress gradients and code-zero bridges

surface_unmeshable.rule: skipped components are omitted from the presentation mesh only; a surface that omits a substrate component is not scorable (SurfaceNotScorable -> surface metrics NOT_RUN)

edge_feedback.scope: Simulator tool-edge pose of the physically held knife (privileged tool proprioception); not material oracle state and not part of the policy observation

gates.scope: home_outcome PASS needs: plan preflight PASS, the trajectory fully executed, grasp never lost, final joints within max_home_joint_error_rad of q_home after settle_s, final tool body pose within the translation/rotation bounds of the tool pose measured right after the reset pregrasp settle, grasp slip/rotation since settling within the bounds (the GraspMonitor warning gates), zero material cut-label changes, zero native unintended tool contacts (palm/table/fixture/other), and the measured joint path passing the same geometric clearance check.

home_outcome.scope: Physical return-to-home only; reported separately from the task outcome

home_measurement.tool_pose_reference: tool body pose measured right after the reset pregrasp settle

measured_path_clearance.scope: Geometry only; declared (uncut) workpiece; knife at the nominal grasp; no dynamics or material

preflight.scope: Geometry only; declared (uncut) workpiece; knife at the nominal grasp; no dynamics or material
Geometry only; declared (uncut) workpiece; knife at the nominal grasp; no dynamics or material

limits.scope: Synchronized trapezoidal joint profiles; Franka Panda limits are 2.175-2.61 rad/s. Commanded joint velocity <= max_velocity on every control step is a hard plan gate; acceleration is enforced for joint-space segments and reported for the Cartesian lift.

deterministic_compilation_note: Raw precommitted sample has max_cuts1 and feasibility duration120s; the existing standard compiler sets two planned cut digits and kinematic14.5s / Native20.5s execution duration. Selected geometry, two goal planes and thresholds are unchanged, verified independently against native_compile of the frozen sample.
